newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran bus crash kills eight schoolgirls, driver.
newsitem.headline: Iran bus crash kills eight schoolgirls, driver.

text.p: Eight schoolgirls were killed in central Iran when a truck crashed into a bus they were travelling in, a newspaper said on Wednesday.

The daily Iran said the driver of the village school bus was also killed and several other students were injured in the accident near Arak, 240 km (150 miles) southwest of Tehran. It did not say when the accident occurred.
